P.h: Tensorlake npm worm wipes your home directory if you revoke its stolen token
P.p: tensorlake@0.5.144 steals developer credentials at install and plants a gh-token-monitor service. If the stolen GitHub token is revoked, the service wipes the home directory. The release came from malicious commits pushed to main under a maintainer's name, so it carries a valid npm provenance attestation.
P.s: Pin to 0.5.143 and remove the service under ~/.config/gh-token-monitor/ before revoking any token. Then rotate every credential the machine held. StepSecurity found the worm spreading through victims' packages and repos.

items.h: Fake TLS certificates issued for Google domains
items.d: Attackers hijacked the .gh, .sl and .as ccTLDs and passed CA domain validation. Google blocked the certs in Chrome. Monitor CT logs and publish restrictive CAA records.

items.h: Five critical Cisco NX-OS flaws allow Nexus takeover
items.d: Remote code execution if NX-API, Next Generation OAM or MPLS OAM is enabled. Disable unneeded features and upgrade to a patched version.

items.h: Copilot CLI runs malware via README prompt injection
items.d: 'env curl ... | env sh' slips past the read-only allowlist, so nothing asks for approval. GitHub called it a known issue and declined a bounty.
Targets exposed LiteLLM, Ollama, Gotenberg and Gitea. Mines Monero and hides C2 addresses in GitHub-hosted poetry.

P.h: AWS and Microsoft ship sandboxes to contain AI agents
P.p: AWS launched Strands Box, an open source sandbox that uses OS-level containment and Dogwood policies on shell, Python, network egress and MCP tools. It raises per-file delete decisions, caps Slack posts at three per ten minutes, and injects secrets at an egress gateway so agents never see them.
P.s: Microsoft made Execution Containers generally available on Windows, with local model support through Windows ML and llama.cpp. GitHub Copilot gets sandboxed tool execution on top.

P.h: The DNS root key changes tomorrow, October 11
P.p: The DNS root switches to KSK-2024 on October 11. DNSSEC-validating resolvers without the new trust anchor can fail to resolve otherwise healthy websites.
P.s: RFC 8509 sentinel queries let operators check readiness, though an unsupported sentinel test gives an inconclusive result rather than proof the key is missing.

tiles.t: Kubelet ignores inodes until it is an emergency
tiles.d: Image GC only watches bytes. Use multi-stage Dockerfiles and alert on inode use above 80%, well before the 95% eviction line.
Incident detection on OpenTelemetry, Kafka and Flink, on 4 pods instead of 90 VMs.
ProxySQL capture exposed MySQL 8.0 regressions before upgrade.
Pair it with SAST and SCA.

items.h: Oracle Health breach climbs to nearly 20M people
items.d: Stolen customer credentials opened a legacy Cerner server not yet moved to Oracle Cloud. Attackers then demanded ransom from hospitals.
